scripts.setup: bun install --cwd apps/admin && bun install --cwd apps/client
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/admin build && bun run --cwd apps/client build
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/admin && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/admin lint && bun run --cwd apps/client lint
scripts.test: cd apps/admin && bun test && cd ../client && bun test && cd ../.. && bun test db
